name: Cantabile
source:
Living her day to day life as a magic scholar and reluctant village aid, Barrisaxe spends a peaceful existence occasionally marked by encounters with her eccentric friend, a man who lives only by the title of the Caviolinier.

When the two of them discover something haunting in the countryside, the consequences of lending a helping hand spiral out of control in ways that neither could expect.

Can Barrisaxe escape her tragic past, or the Caviolinier his? Or will they be drawn back into those dark times, never to return?

[From [url=https://sirenrock.itch.io/cantabile]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
巴里萨克斯以魔法学者和不情愿的村庄援助的身份过着日常生活，过着平静的生活，偶尔会遇到她古怪的朋友，一个只靠卡维林尼尔头衔生活的人。

当他们两人在乡村发现一些令人难以忘怀的事情时，伸出援助之手的后果以双方都没有预料到的方式失控。

Barrisaxe能否逃脱她悲惨的过去，或者Caviolinier能否逃脱他的悲惨过去？或者他们会被拉回到那些黑暗的时代，再也不会回来吗？

[来自[url=https://sirenrock.itch.io/cantabile]itch.io[/url]]
